fields.label: Payroll Cycle Start Day
fields.description: Day the payroll period starts. 1 = calendar month. 23 = period runs from day 23 of the previous month to day 22 of the current month.

fields.label: Overtime Multiplier
fields.description: Overtime = (daily salary ÷ normal daily hours) × this factor × overtime hours. Default 2×.

fields.label: Working Days Basis
fields.description: Auto: calendar days minus holidays (and, with Validate Attendance, minus absences/unpaid leave). Standard: a fixed number of working days.

fields.label: Standard Working Days
fields.description: Fixed total working days used when the basis is Standard.

fields.label: Subsídio de Férias (% of Base)
fields.description: Vacation Allowance as a % of base salary. Excluded from the INSS base.

fields.label: Subsídio de Natal (% of Base)
fields.description: Christmas Allowance as a % of base salary. Paid in the configured Natal Payment Month (13th month); included in the INSS base.

fields.label: Natal Payment Month
fields.options:
January
February
March
April
May
June
July
August
September
October
November
December
fields.description: The payroll period that ends in this month includes the Subsídio de Natal (default December).

fields.label: Settlement Salary Days (Divisor)
fields.description: Monthly working-day divisor for the proportional salary daily rate (base + allowances ÷ this). Default 26.

fields.label: Settlement Leave Days (Divisor)
fields.description: Monthly divisor for the untaken-annual-leave daily rate (base ÷ this). Default 22.

fields.label: Normal Weekly Hours (Hs)
fields.description: Artigo 237.º n.º 7: S/H = (Sm × 12) / (52 × Hs). Needed only when a settlement uses the statutory hourly basis.

fields.label: Include Meal and Transport in Leave Pay
fields.description: Artigo 213.º n.º 2 excludes them from leave remuneration unless the parties agreed otherwise. Tick only where a contract or collective agreement says so.

fields.label: Compensation Tax Position
fields.description: IRT incidence on termination compensation is not settled between the consolidated Código do IRT and the commentary on Lei n.º 28/20. This is a COMPANY TAX POSITION, not a statutory rate.
Credited with the net pay. An Employee's own Payroll Payable Account overrides this.
fields.label: Payroll Payable Account

fields.description: Bank/Cash account credited when salaries are paid (the Payment Entry). Can be overridden when posting.
fields.label: Salary Payment Account
Payroll Preview Columns (JSON)
fields.description: Managed from the dashboard — order/visibility of the payroll preview columns.

fields.label: Require Separate Payroll Approval
fields.description: The user who submits a payroll for approval may not approve it. Disable only if a company is too small to separate the duties — the risk is that one person can prepare and approve payroll alone.

fields.label: Require Separate Payment Approval
fields.description: The user who approved a payroll may not authorise its payment.

fields.label: Payroll Variance Threshold (%)
fields.description: Gross or net pay changing by more than this versus the previous period raises a readiness warning.

fields.label: Require Separate Contract Approval
fields.description: The user who submits an employment contract may not approve it.

fields.label: Require Separate Salary Change Approval
fields.description: The user who requests a salary change may not approve it.

fields.label: Contract Expiry Reminders (days)
fields.description: Comma-separated. Contracts ending within the largest value are shown as Expiring.

fields.label: Probation Review Window (days)
fields.description: How long before a probation ends the review is flagged as due.
